# clavis sets show

<p class="cli-lead">Show a shared set</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis sets show SET [flags]
```

</div>

Show a set's keys. `--reveal` decrypts the values (audited).

## Examples

```sh
clavis sets show shared-api --reveal
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-reveal"><dt><code>--reveal</code></dt><dd>decrypt values (requires secrets:read-values)</dd></div>
</dl>
